import urllib.request, urllib.parse, re, html, os

queries = [
    '"Duan Yihe" NUS',
    '"Duan Yihe" "Electrical and Computer Engineering"',
    'site:nus.edu.sg "Duan Yihe"',
    'site:comp.nus.edu.sg "Duan Yihe"',
    'site:ece.nus.edu.sg "Duan Yihe"',
    '"Yihe Duan" NUS',
]

def fetch(u):
    req = urllib.request.Request(u, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120 Safari/537.36'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
        return r.get_status(), r.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')

for i, q in enumerate(queries):
    enc = urllib.parse.quote(q)
    urls = [
        ('ddg', 'https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=' + enc),
        ('bing', 'https://www.bing.com/search?q=' + enc),
        ('google', 'https://www.google.com/search?q=' + enc),
    ]
    for name, u in urls:
        try:
            st, d = fetch(u)
            fn = f'out_{i}_{name}.html'
            open(fn, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(d)
            print('OK', q, name, st, len(d))
        except Exception as e:
            print('ERR', q, name, repr(e))
